entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A red-aligned half-devil human planeswalker from Innistrad, an empath of pain who impersonated Valki on Kaldheim, was compleated and was killed by Tyvar Kell.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Tibalt's dark home plane.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Innistrad province where Tibalt apprenticed to a Skaberen.

entities.name: Devils
entities.description: Creatures who gathered near Tibalt's laboratory and gave him insights into pain.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker Tibalt sought to torment on Innistrad.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: Diabolist who fought alongside Tibalt's army and visited Urborg with him.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Phyrexian who ambushed Tibalt and infected him with phyresis.

entities.name: Valki
entities.description: The real god of lies, imprisoned by Tibalt in Karfell.

entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: King of Karfell, whose dungeon held Valki.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Elf planeswalker who investigated 'Valki' and killed the compleated Tibalt.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who found Tibalt rallying the trolls of Gnottvold.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Artifact stolen from Koll and used by Tibalt to open an Omenpath and escape; returned to Halvar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The war event Tibalt triggered, in which thousands of demons led by Varragoth attacked another realm.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Demon master of the Skelle clan who leads demons in the Doomskar.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Tibalt impersonated Valki.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who dueled alongside compleated Tibalt, and who helped Chandra on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker traumatized by Tibalt's pain magic.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Pyromancer planeswalker whom Tibalt tormented and who knocked him out.

entities.name: Compleated Tibalt
entities.description: Phyrexian-compleated version of Tibalt, a mess of bony plates with two stingers dripping glistening oil.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon whose use of the Immortal Sun trapped Tibalt on Ravnica.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: True owner of the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Koll
entities.description: Dwarf blacksmith killed by Tibalt for the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Where Tibalt was lured by the Interplanar Beacon in the War of the Spark.

events.summary: Failing as an apprentice Skaberen, Tibalt isolates himself and experiments on living creatures' limits of pain, eventually using people.
events.quote: eventually, he moved on to people

events.summary: Devils gather at Tibalt's laboratory and teach him the nature of pain.
events.quote: they sought to assist him, offering Tibalt insights into his obsession, the very nature of pain

events.summary: Caught by inquisitors, Tibalt fuses his essence with the devils; the trauma ignites his spark and he is flung across the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: The shock and trauma ignited Tibalt's spark

events.summary: Tibalt decides to interfere with Sorin Markov on Innistrad to torment him.
events.quote: Tibalt decided that he had to interfere

events.summary: Tibalt is lured to Ravnica and trapped; he fights the Eternals while tormenting civilians and leads demons and devils with Davriel Cane.
events.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the diabolist Davriel Cane .

events.summary: Vorinclex ambushes Tibalt, infects him with phyresis and holds him hostage.
events.quote: Tibalt was ambushed by Vorinclex , who infected him with phyresis

events.summary: Tibalt imprisons Valki in Karfell and assumes his identity, spreading chaos across the realms.
events.quote: Tibalt deceived the god Valki and imprisoned him in magical chains

events.summary: Tibalt, using the Sword, opens an Omenpath for Koma in Starnheim and escapes Tyvar and Kaya to Immersturm.
events.quote: Using the Sword, Tibalt escaped both his enemies into the realm of Immersturm .

events.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before losing the Sword, and demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
events.quote: Led by Varragoth, thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm.

events.summary: Fully compleated, Tibalt and Ajani duel Tyvar and Elspeth at the Seedcore walkway.
events.quote: At some point, Tibalt was fully compleated.

events.summary: Tyvar covers Tibalt in hexgold and stabs him in the heart with his own stingers; Tibalt falls to his death.
events.quote: Tibalt fell from the Basilica into the depths of the Spheres, killing him.

events.summary: After the War of the Spark Tibalt confronts Chandra on Zendikar and drives her to planeswalk away.
events.quote: he unleashed an attack on Chandra that caused her to planeswalk away from Zendikar

events.summary: Tibalt tortures Chandra's mother on Kaladesh, then is overwhelmed and knocked out by Chandra and locked in a rune-enforced prison.
events.quote: She knocked him out and delivered him to the local authorities to deal with.

relations.note: Stabbed him through the heart with his own stingers.
relations.quote: used them to stab Tibalt in the heart

relations.note: Meant to torment the ancient walker.
relations.quote: just to torment the ancient walker
Tibalt deceived the god Valki and imprisoned him in magical chains

relations.note: Dueled alongside him as a Phyrexian.
relations.quote: He and Ajani dueled Tyvar and Elspeth
